caption: The video captures a wide, calm expanse of water stretching toward a low, tree-covered shoreline. Small houses and thin masts dot the distance. A pale blue sky holds soft clouds, including a brighter band on the left that mirrors as a faint reflection on the surface. Short ripples and wavelets continuously shift and re-form across the foreground, keeping the water in gentle, ongoing motion rather than a still mirror. The bright reflection patch subtly changes shape and position as the surface moves. The distant shoreline, buildings, masts, and clouds remain largely fixed in view, with no obvious pan, tilt, or zoom.
